# TaiwanHaul

> TaiwanHaul (https://taiwanhaul.com) helps travelers — initially from Southeast Asia — discover products worth buying in Taiwan: items that are cheaper than back home, classic must-buys, and picks recommended by Taiwanese locals. Visitors can search in their own language; the site maps queries to Chinese shopping terms.

Status: early MVP. All prices, exchange rates, search results and recommendations are sample data, not live listings.

## Page sections

- Search: one search box; accepts English, Traditional Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese, Malay/Indonesian and more.
- Cheaper in Taiwan: price comparison between Taiwan and the visitor's market (SG, MY, TH, VN, PH).
- Taiwan must-buy: curated classic souvenirs.
- Recommended by Taiwanese: editorial picks with local tips.
- Contact: a form in a dialog (the visitor submits it themselves).

## URL parameters

- `?q=<query>` runs a search on load, e.g. https://taiwanhaul.com/?q=pineapple%20cake
- `?lang=en|zh-TW|th|vi|ms|fil` sets the UI language.
- `?market=SG|MY|TH|VN|PH` sets the visitor market used for price comparisons.

## WebMCP tools

In browsers that support WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext`), the page registers:

- `search_taiwan_products` { query, market? } — search; results also appear on the page.
- `list_featured_products` { section: cheaper | must_buy | recommended, market? }
- `set_preferences` { locale?, market? }
- `open_contact_form` { topic?, message? } — opens and pre-fills the form; never submits it.
